about_the_game:
The Anubis Treasure

Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover ancient secrets in this 2D adventure set within the mysterious pyramids of Egypt.

▣ A journey shrouded in mystery

The sands of time have concealed a legendary secret for centuries: The Treasure of Anubis. Many have sought it… but none have returned.

In this 2D platforming adventure, you take on the role of a young archaeologist who, after multiple failed expeditions, is given one final chance to prove his worth. This time, there is no room for failure.

To reach the Great Gate, you must gather the 9 Sacred Keys, overcome deadly traps, solve ancient puzzles, and explore forgotten temples filled with secrets.

But remember…
you are not alone.

Key Features

• Your mission: Collect the 9 Sacred Keys and unlock the legendary Treasure of Anubis
• Puzzles & exploration: Activate mechanisms, avoid traps, and test your wit
• Achievement system:

  • 30 in-game achievements to challenge your skills

  • 15 Steam achievements with unique objectives
    • Varied gameplay: Platforming, exploration, stealth, and puzzle-solving

Hidden Collectibles

• 3 special coins in every level
• 16 Egyptian busts hidden throughout the pyramids
• 25 secret treasures scattered across the game

Side Quests

• Collect 3 scarab amulets for the photographer
• Find the hidden boomerang
• Discover the mysterious Book of Anum

Multiple Endings

Your choices and discoveries matter.
Unlock 4 different endings based on your progress, without needing to restart the game.

Content & Duration

• 36 main levels + sublevels
• Estimated playtime: 4 to 15 hours

Visual Style

Minimalist 2D graphics that emphasize clarity and charm, delivering a smooth experience focused on gameplay.

Original Soundtrack

Immerse yourself in a unique atmosphere with over 41 original music tracks.
A fusion of traditional Egyptian instruments and modern arrangements that accompany every discovery, puzzle, and challenge.

Technical Details

• Genre: Adventure / 2D Platformer / Puzzle
• Languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Croatian, Hindi, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish
• Players: 1 (offline)
• Difficulty:

  • Gameplay: Easy

  • Exploration: Medium

  • Puzzles: Medium – Hard

Are you ready?

The desert hides secrets.
The pyramids test the brave.

The Anubis Treasure awaits.
Dare to enter… if you can escape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with WDDM 1.0 driver
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard or gamepad recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Tarjeta gráfica compatible con DirectX 11 o posterior con controlador WDDM 1.0.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard or gamepad recommended
